verdict.rationale: Plausible ships an official web tracking script with SPA support, plus WordPress and GTM installs. Its documented Events API lets mobile (Android/iOS) and server-side apps send pageviews and custom events. However, the evidence shows no official language or platform SDKs: mobile and backend ingestion means hand-rolling raw HTTP calls. missing for 10: official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), official backend SDKs for major languages, published SDK documentation or an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), independent corroboration of multi-platform ingestion.
